metadata.title: The Blue Reel — A1
metadata.synopsis: Uma bobina esquecida no cinema leva Iris a escolher entre descobrir um filme e encontrar quem o deixou.

scenes.title: After the Last Film
scenes.narration: Iris cleans a small cinema at night. Under a seat, she finds a blue film reel in a yellow bag. The bag is dry and clean. "Someone was here today. This is not old rubbish." She takes the bag to the projection room. A small white envelope is inside.

scenes.title: A Note for the Cinema
scenes.narration: In the projection room, Iris opens the envelope. The note says the film shows this cinema many years ago. There is no name on the note. "The old picture on this shelf may help me." In the picture, a young man holds a blue reel. Iris knows his face.

scenes.title: The Man in the Picture
scenes.narration: The man in the picture is Mr Hale. He has a flower shop near the cinema. Iris puts the blue reel beside the projector. The machine works. "I can watch the film, or take the bag to his shop." She has time for one visit before she goes home.

scenes.title: The First Evening
scenes.narration: Iris watches the film. On the screen, young Mr Hale opens the cinema doors for the first time. His family stands beside him. At the end, he waves. "Now I know why this little film is important." She keeps the reel safe. Tomorrow, she will invite him to watch it with her.

scenes.title: A Present Returned
scenes.narration: Iris takes the yellow bag to the flower shop. Mr Hale looks at the blue reel and smiles. He left it at the cinema as a present. "I forgot to write my name. Thank you for finding me." Iris asks him to bring his family to the cinema. They can tell the story together.
